notes_en:
Image Translator Button UI/UX Unification & Responsive Symmetry
1. **100% Unified Button UI/UX**: Standardized border styling, background translucency, rounded-xl radius, Theme Accent brand icons, and typography for "Take Photo" and "Choose Image" buttons.
2. **50%/50% Responsive Equal-Width Symmetry**: Implemented responsive grid-cols-2 layout. Automatically splits widths 50%/50% on mobile screens and presents perfectly centered equal-width symmetry on desktop screens.
3. **Smart Camera Un-Mirroring**: Front cameras and PC/macOS webcams automatically un-mirror captured photos, ensuring identical left-to-right readable text in both Lexicon UI and AI OCR.
4. **README Documentation Alignment**: Removed obsolete long-image export claims in both Chinese and English READMEs to match the current product design.
